title: goniopteris reptans
intro: Goniopteris reptans, commonly known as the African fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can help to reduce pain, swelling, and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Goniopteris reptans include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral agent, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions such as wounds, infections, and fever. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
